name: dsh-vscode
description: Run the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent inside VS Code, with per-repository sessions and workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
DeepSeek Harness is starting.

If this message stays, run **DSH: Show Diagnostics** from the Command Palette.

dshVscode.dshPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `dsh` executable or entry script. Leave empty to auto-detect: `dsh` on `PATH`, then a checkout named by `#dshVscode.dshCheckout#`, then `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`.

dshVscode.dshCheckout.markdownDescription: Path to a DeepSeek Harness source checkout. The runtime is launched as `node <checkout>/apps/cli/lib/bin.js`. Leave empty to auto-detect next to this workspace.

dshVscode.dshNode.markdownDescription: Node.js binary used to run a `#dshVscode.dshCheckout#`. Empty resolves the newest suitable runtime from `PATH`, `$DSH_NODE`, `$FNM_MULTISHELL_PATH`, `$NVM_BIN`, and finally the extension host runtime. DeepSeek Harness needs Node 22.19 or newer.

dshVscode.dshHome.markdownDescription: Value for `DSH_HOME` (credentials, profiles, model cache). Leave empty to inherit the default `~/.dsh`, which keeps credentials global while sessions stay in the repository.

enumDescriptions: $DSH_HOME/workspaces/<repository>-<hash>. Nothing inside the repository at all; still one store per repository.
<repository>/.git/dsh. Inside the repository folder but outside the working tree, so Git can never see it.
<repository>/.dsh in the working tree. The extension also adds it to .git/info/exclude and writes .dsh/.gitignore, so it stays out of Git.
The absolute path in dshVscode.dataDir (~ and ${workspaceFolder} are expanded).
dshVscode.storageLocation.markdownDescription: Where this repository's DSH sessions, storage, and chat history are kept. Use **DSH: Change Session Storage Location** to move existing data.

dshVscode.dataDir.markdownDescription: Directory that holds this repository's sessions (see `#dshVscode.storageLocation#`). Relative paths resolve against the repository root; `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded; an absolute path is used as is.

dshVscode.provider.description: LLM provider route for every agent the extension starts.

dshVscode.model.description: Model for every agent the extension starts.

dshVscode.reasoningEffort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort handed to the provider. Empty keeps the model default. The runtime validates the exact route at startup and reports an unsupported value.

dshVscode.maxTokens.description: Output token cap per request. 0 keeps the model default.

enumDescriptions: The agent may read but not write, and every escalation is refused.
The agent writes inside this repository and cannot reach outside it. Out-of-sandbox escalations fail closed because the SDK protocol cannot surface an approval prompt.
No sandbox and no approvals. The agent may run anything as your user account.
dshVscode.permissionMode.markdownDescription: Sandbox mode for the agent, passed as `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE`.

dshVscode.autoStart.description: Start the harness runtime as soon as the extension activates in a repository.

dshVscode.showReasoning.description: Show the model's reasoning blocks in the chat transcript.

dshVscode.animateChunks.description: Reveal each answer in the sidebar progressively. The SDK protocol delivers a message only after its step commits, so this animates a finished answer rather than streaming tokens; the saved transcript always holds the complete text.

dshVscode.includeEditorContext.description: Tell the agent which file and selection are active when you send a message.

dshVscode.userPatch.markdownDescription: Repository-relative patch file whose rows are appended after the extension's own rows, for advanced composition such as MCP servers or extra plugins. It is read from `#dshVscode.dataDir#`.

dshVscode.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to every `dsh` launch.

dshVscode.webUi.port.description: Port for the DSH Web UI the extension can launch for this repository.

dshVscode.webUi.trustedHosts.description: Extra authorities passed as repeatable --trusted-host to the DSH Web UI.

dshVscode.trace.description: Log every protocol frame and runtime stderr line to the DSH output channel.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && node test/smoke-activation.mjs && node test/smoke-webview.mjs && npm run test:e2e:offline
scripts.test:smoke: node esbuild.mjs --production && node test/smoke-activation.mjs && node test/smoke-webview.mjs
